changelog:
🚀 Core engine updated with performance optimizations

✨ New Features:
• Smart Auto-Detect: Automatically scans your network and applies the best protocol, MTU, bypass, and transport settings
• Smart Disconnection Alert: Shows an immediate notification with a reconnect button when VPN drops unexpectedly
• Re-Test button to re-run the full network auto-detection
• Internet Speed Test: Measure download, upload, ping & jitter with real-time live stats
• Speed Test Settings: Choose server (Cloudflare/Ofakino), display unit (MB/s or Mb/s), test size, and ping samples
• Manual Protocol Selection: Choose MASQUE, WireGuard, or Gool with recommended settings directly from Auto-Detect screen

🔧 Improvements:
• More accurate latency measurement using multi-sample TCP/HTTPS probes with median calculation
• Improved DPI detection and ISP fingerprinting
• Better network environment analysis for optimal protocol selection
• Speed Test progress card now shows real-time ping, download speed, and upload speed during testing

🐛 Bug Fixes:
• Fixed notification crash on Android when VPN disconnects unexpectedly
• Fixed connection status not updating correctly after unexpected disconnection
• Fixed overlay spacing issue on Windows protocol detection screen
• Fixed status bar padding on Android protocol detection screen
